why_it_fails: Stage: website discovery. No Ascend entry in locators.CONNECTORS, and the registry name "Ascend Cannabis Outlet by InLabs" shares only the word "ascend" with the live storefront title "Ascend Dispensary - Northlake" (site_discovery.business_words strips dispensary/cannabis; remaining {ascend, outlet, by, inlabs} must overlap >=2 with the result block), so by-name search is weak. Per the lead, the fallback web search is currently dead (DuckDuckGo returns a 202 bot challenge, Bing returns unrelated pages); the stored evidence for this store is a Bing 200 plus a DuckDuckGo ConnectTimeout. Once a URL is found the rest is straightforward: address 39 W North Ave matches the Dutchie location.ln1 exactly.
fix_idea: Chain-level Ascend connector (ascend-store-mapper GeoJSON): match addresses_match("39 W North Ave.", "39 W North Avenue") or the coordinate pin, take shop_url, let dutchie_page_endpoints() produce dutchie.com/embedded-menu/671c08fde21b5073ab1fd4ea. Make the connector regex match the brand anywhere in the name and the InLabs licensee string: r"\bascend\b|inlabs", so "Midway by Ascend" and "Ascend Cannabis Outlet by InLabs" both hit.
